description:
Match one of YOUR open requests now (POST /api/v1/marketplace/request/{id}/rematch) — your own instruction, any speed. A request is open while it
    reads pending or partially_matched and its window has not ended; a machine-speed request reopens after a failed fund or a
    delivery-timeout refund. Machine speed: each match is escrowed from your wallet at once, as market_request does. Human speed: the
    match waits for the provider's approval. 409 request_not_open / request_window_ended.
name: market_request_rematch
